portraits.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a high-resolution 2048x2048 hyperrealistic cinematic creature portrait for Global Plumbing Initiative marketing. SINGLE full-body sentient toilet monster, faithful to the game's original design: aged ivory porcelain toilet bowl and rear cistern, lid lowered as angry eyebrow, two blazing coral-red eyes just under lid, snarling bowl mouth with several blunt porcelain teeth, two short articulated plumbing-pipe legs with heavy porcelain feet. Three-quarter view facing left. Physically realistic glazed ceramic, small cracks, grime, condensation, corroded metal joints; eerie credible practical creature effects, NOT pixel art or cartoon illustration. Creature completely in frame, strong readable silhouette, dark damp basement with subtle copper pipes and shallow depth of field, cool teal rim light and warm eye glow, dramatic premium film poster photography. No humans, no other monsters, no writing, no logos, no borders. No gore. Preserve toilet anatomy and funny-menacing personality. Single marketing portrait, not sprite atlas.
